title: Pre-Removal Checklist
description: Complete before the engine hoist ever touches the car.

items.text: Diagnostic scan performed and all fault codes logged
VIN-specific parts list confirmed (WBAFF01070L319611)
Workshop manual chapters reviewed for Engine Removal
Wire Labeling System set up and printed labels ready
All required tools present and functional
Vehicle on level ground with wheels chocked
Battery disconnected and radio/nav codes recorded
Fluids drained into labeled containers (oil, coolant, A/C if applicable)
Photos taken of full engine bay from multiple angles
Parts organizer bins labeled by removal stage

title: Engine Removal Checklist
description: Step-by-step confirmation while pulling the engine.

items.text: Front bumper / clip removed
Radiator pack removed and stored safely
All engine harness connectors labeled and disconnected
Fuel lines disconnected and capped
Exhaust downpipe disconnected from turbo
A/C compressor unbolted and set aside without opening refrigerant circuit
Transmission bellhousing separated
Engine mounts unbolted with hoist supporting full weight
Engine lifted clear with no snagged lines/hoses
Engine placed on stand and old engine photographed for records

title: Engine Bay Cleaning Checklist
description: Deep clean while the bay is empty and fully accessible.

items.text: Degrease and pressure wash bay (electrical components protected/covered)
Inspect subframe and body for rust or damage
Inspect and clean all ground points to bare metal
Wire harness inspected for chafing/heat damage and repaired if needed
Touch-up paint/rust treatment applied where needed
Engine bay insulation/sound deadening inspected
All fasteners sorted, cleaned, and matched to torque spec list
Bay dried and photographed clean before install

title: Replacement Engine Inspection Checklist
description: Verify the replacement engine before it goes anywhere near the car.

items.text: Engine code and casting numbers match required application
Compression / leak-down test performed on all 6 cylinders
Crank turned by hand — smooth with no binding
Oil pan dropped and bottom end visually inspected
Main and rod bearings inspected regardless of stated mileage
Timing chain and guides inspected/replaced
Turbochargers bench-checked for shaft play
All sensors and glow plugs tested
External engine cleaned and repainted where appropriate
Full gasket set and seals ready for installation
Engine lowered onto mounts with hoist support until fully secured
Engine mount bolts torqued per TQ-007 / TQ-008
Transmission bellhousing bolted per TQ-009, converter per TQ-010
All wiring harness connectors reconnected and matched to wire labels
All grounding straps reconnected per TQ-026
Fuel system reconnected with new seals per Fuel System chapter
Cooling system hoses reconnected and clamped
Turbo oil/coolant lines reconnected and primed
Radiator pack and front bumper reinstalled
All fluids filled to correct level (oil, coolant, transmission)
Final visual sweep for tools/rags left in bay

title: First Start Checklist
description: Critical safety sequence for the first startup after install.

items.text: Battery reconnected, negative last
Battery registered via coding tool
Ignition on (no crank) — check dash for warning lights and DDE wake-up
Full diagnostic scan for stored faults before first crank
Oil pressure pre-check (crank with fuel disabled if possible, per chapter procedure)
Fire extinguisher on hand, area clear, ventilation adequate
First start performed, engine allowed to idle only — watch oil pressure and temperature
Immediate shutdown if any abnormal noise, warning light, or fluid leak observed
Leak-check entire bay after idle (oil, coolant, fuel, boost)
Injector correction codes and glow plug cycle confirmed via diagnostic tool

title: Test Drive Checklist
description: Before and after the first real drive.

items.text: Fluid levels rechecked after idle/warm-up cycle
Wheel bolts torqued per TQ-022 and re-torque scheduled at 50km
Brakes tested at low speed before leaving the property
Short low-speed drive first, monitoring gauges continuously
Listen for boost leaks, exhaust leaks, or unusual drivetrain noise
Full diagnostic scan after test drive for any new codes
Post-drive visual inspection for leaks under the vehicle
Log test drive results in Maintenance Log
